rules.name: Dirty Fighter
rules.description: Whenever Eugene attacks in melee and loses or draws, immediately add 1 red die to his melee attack roll.

rules.name: Stab!
rules.description: Eugene may reroll any or all of his melee attack dice when using a weapon with the "Sharp" keyword.

rules.name: The Muscle
rules.description: If Harold is on the winning side in melee and choose to attack, his side inflicts 1 extra point of damage against the enemy.

rules.name: Scrapper
rules.description: Harold always wins in a drawn combat, even when he is fighting other Survivors and his side doesn`t have the Initiative.

rules.name: Healer
rules.description:
As an Action, Alice may restore 1 red die health lost earlier in the game, to herself or a friendly model in her Kill Zone. Alice may use Bandages on any other model within her Kill Zone.
When Alice uses any item of equipment that restores lost wounds, she restores 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Medical Professional
rules.description:
As an Action, Stevens may restore 1 white die health lost earlier in the game, to himself or a friendly model in his Kill Zone. Stevens may use Bandages on any other model within his Kill Zone.
When Stevens uses any item that restores lost wounds, he restores 1 extra wound.

rules.name: The Muscle
rules.description: If Bruce is on the winning side in melee and choose to attack, his side inflicts 1 extra point of damage against the enemy.

rules.name: Die Hard
rules.description: Gloria deducts 1 point of damage inflicted against her in each melee.

rules.name: Bottom of a Bottle
rules.description:
At the start of each of Bob`s activations, before Panic is rolled, roll a black die.
On a Shield, Bob`s Nerve is High this turn.
On a blank, his Nerve is Low.

rules.name: Patch-Up
rules.description:
Bob may use Bandages on any other model within his Kill Zone.
When Bob uses any item that restores lost wounds, he restores 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Right-Hand Man
rules.description: If Brian Blake is in the same group and is removed as a casualty, Martinez immediately gains Brian`s Leader ability, and counts as the group Leader from that point on.

rules.name: Wall Guard
rules.description: Martinez and all friendly models within his Kill Zone may reroll blanks when making a Shoot Action.

rules.name: Bodyguard
rules.description: If Brian Blake is in the same group and is targeted by a ranged attack while within Gabe`s Kill Zone, Gabe may take the attack on his behalf. Gabe becomes the new target, even if he was not initially within range or line of sight.

rules.name: Out of Shape
rules.description: Gabe can only Sneak 3", and Run 6".

rules.name: Brutal
rules.description: When the Governor is on the winning side in a melee, add 1 white die to the damage caused.

rules.name: Hard to Kill
rules.description:
Each time the Governor suffers 2 or more damage from a single attack, roll a black die.
On a shield, reduce the number of wounds inflicted against him by 1.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Be More Afraid of Me...
rules.description: Any friendly model within the Governor`s Kill Zone uses his Nerve value instead of its own.

rules.name: Executioner
rules.description:
Brian never makes attack rolls against prone enemy Survivors.
Instead, they are automatically removed once he declares his attack.
Each model removed in this way adds 1 red die to Brian`s special dice pool.

rules.name: Hates Cowardice
rules.description: If a friendly model within 6" of Brian is Panicking and Brian is not engaged, he lashes out. The model loses 1 health. If it survives, it ignores the Panic rules for that turn.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Kill Them All!
rules.description:
Each time Brian sucessfully wounds an enemy Survivor, add 1 white die to a special pool on this card.
Any model in Brian`s group may add one of these dice to any attack roll.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Mind Games
rules.description: Once per game, Lilly may steal the Initiative from her opponent. If both groups contain a Leader with this ability, the Initiative may be stolen back again!

rules.name: Guilty Conscience
rules.description: Whenever Smitty takes another Survivor out of action (or is on the side in melee that does), roll a Black die. On a blank, he loses 1 Action in his next activation.

rules.name: Hunter
rules.description: Smitty does not halve his movement when moving through Area Terrain.

rules.name: Shove!
rules.description: At the start of the combat in which Tom is engaged, before any attack dice are rolled, he may roll one Black die for one enemy in base contact. On a Shield, the model is moved 1" away from Tom, exactly as if it had been pushed back, and may not take part in the melee.

rules.name: Adrenaline Junkie
rules.description: While the Threat Level is High, Wes gains one extra Action each turn.

rules.name: Trophy Collector
rules.description: If Brian removes a Survivor from play in Melee without a !, he receives 1 Searched Supply Counter.

rules.name: That's Entertainment
rules.description: As an Action, Brian my push any Survivor in his Kill Zone up to 2" as long as this moves them towards an enemy model.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Do As I Say
rules.description:
Once per activation, Brian may Make NOISE and choose a Friendly Woodbury Army Survivor within 10". 

That Survivor immediately activates, interrupting Brian's activation. This is not an Action.
